loginCheck: window.__CONN.loggedIn() — composer present means signed in; a Google sign-in wall => login_required.
fallbackFor: No AI-Studio CLI; this IS the surface. Strength: fast native multimodal (audio/video transcription) + very large context.

default.desc: Standard chat turn (pick model in the switcher if a tier is required).

transcribe.desc: Audio/video -> verbatim transcript + targeted quote verification (the project's core use). Upload media via command.uploads, then prompt.
transcribe.activate: Open insert/upload control; file_upload each media file; wait until each attachment is ready.

long_context.desc: Large-document review (AI Studio's big context window). Upload the doc(s), then prompt.

promptSyntax.notes: System instructions can be set in the right panel but prefer inline framing for one-off turns. One task per turn.

settle.streamingSignal: a Stop control present / the Run button disabled => still generating
settle.doneSignal: the Run button re-enabled AND the last response stops growing

selectors.runBtn: NO aria-label — driver matches by visible text /^Run/; CSS fallback: ms-run-button button, run-button button
selectors.uploadBtn: button[aria-label*="Insert" i], button[aria-label*="Upload" i], button[aria-label*="add" i], input[type="file"]

downloads: Files land in the OS Downloads dir; connector returns the name, Code resolves the newest match.
warnings: Angular Material, ms-* custom elements. The Run button has NO aria-label — match by visible text 'Run' or submit with Ctrl+Enter. Insert into the <textarea> via the native value setter + an 'input' event (Angular ignores el.value=...). ms-chat-turn innerText carries Material icon ligatures (more_vert/thumb_up/thumb_down) — strip them (the driver's lastText does).
verified_2026_06_25: Live-tested in an authenticated browser. CONFIRMED: composer 'ms-prompt-box textarea'; insert via native value-setter + input event; submit via Ctrl+Enter (real key) OR clicking the text-'Run' button; responses in 'ms-chat-turn'; CLEAN settle = Run re-enabled AND no Stop; per-prompt permalink /prompts/<id> is the warm-thread id. CORRECTED: prior best-effort runBtn 'button[aria-label*=Run]' does NOT match (Run has no aria-label). NOT yet exercised: the multimodal upload control (transcribe mode) - calibrate it on the first media run.

routing.warnBanner: SENSITIVE DATA: external free-tier processing may retain or train on submitted data. Require current explicit approval.
routing.localFreeAlternative: Use an approved on-device transcription tool when available.
